title: Loan limit and a gentler fine at a library desk
prompt:
Change the lending rules of the library desk.

1. Loan limit. A member may have at most 3 books on loan at the same time. A `borrow` for a member who already has 3 prints `error: NAME already has 3 books` and lends nothing. This check comes after the other `borrow` checks (bad day, unknown member, unknown book, book already on loan).
2. Fines. A book that comes back at most 3 days after its due day costs nothing (a grace period). A book that comes back later costs 10 cents for every day after its due day (the grace days are counted too: 5 days late costs $0.50), but never more than $5.00 per book. The message of a `return` after the due day is `NAME returned ID N days late, fine $X` as before when there is a fine, and `NAME returned ID N days late, no fine` when the fine is zero because of the grace period; N is always the number of days after the due day. A book returned on or before its due day still prints `... on time`.

Everything else must behave as it does now.

cases.name: example
cases.stdin:
member ann
book b1 Dune
book b2 Emma
borrow ann b1 10
return ann b1 27
borrow ann b2 30
return ann b2 80
fines ann
cases.expected_output:
welcome ann
added book b1: Dune
added book b2: Emma
ann borrowed b1, due day 24
ann returned b1 3 days late, no fine
ann borrowed b2, due day 44
ann returned b2 36 days late, fine $3.60
ann owes $3.60
